message.content: In the conversation, LiHua expresses admiration for Gerard Piqué, describing him as someone who "had that combination of skill and intelligence in defense." LiHua mentions that alongside Carles Puyol, Gerard Piqué is one of the notable defenders in the history of FC Barcelona. LiHua also notes that Piqué brought "something special" to the team with his ability to read the game and score crucial goals, further highlighting his importance to the club. LiHua appreciates Piqué's leadership and fighting spirit, which she believes contributed significantly to the team's success.
